description.value: The Port Hardy branch of the Vancouver Island Regional Library has served this northernmost Vancouver Island community since 1972, situated on the unceded traditional territory of the Kwakwaka'wakw peoples. As a full-service public library, it offers books, digital resources, computers, and meeting room facilities to the public at no charge. For touring cyclists reaching the end of the Island Highway, it provides a welcoming indoor rest stop with community resources in a remote location.
